title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limit

translated_title: 面向科学的机器学习自动化：前沿智能体能否在真实环境中攀登科学之峰？
translated_abstract: 前沿编码智能体日益被定位为端到端的自动化研究者，而“面向科学的机器学习”为检验这一承诺提供了一个高要求的试金石：改进一个科学模型往往需要超越常规机器学习工程的领域洞察。我们提出了 Agent4Sci，一个长时程测试平台，用于衡量当今的智能体能在多大程度上改进科学机器学习基准上已发表的最佳模型，涵盖 11 个领域的 20 个基准。Agent4Sci 并非通过排行榜为智能体排名，而是探讨智能体在真实条件下能在这些任务上取得哪些类型的进展，以及它们在何处存在不足。实验表明，当今的前沿智能体在所有基准上都推进了已发表的最佳结果，其中 Claude Opus 达到了 10.4% 的平均相对改进，且没有任何一次运行被标记为学术不端。然而，这些提升几乎完全来自一系列机器学习工程技巧，而非研究层面的洞察。轨迹分析揭示了三个反复出现的局限……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了长时程测试平台 Agent4Sci（涵盖 11 个领域的 20 个科学机器学习基准），发现前沿智能体能在所有基准上超越已发表的最佳模型（Claude Opus 平均相对改进 10.4%），但这些进展几乎完全来自机器学习工程技巧而非研究级的科学洞察。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed spanning 20 scientific ML benchmarks across 11 domains, showing that frontier agents can advance the published best results on every benchmark (Claude Opus achieving 10.4% mean relative improvement), yet these gains stem almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level scientific insight.
